cards.claim: The Conservative Party selected as its candidate Donald Box for the Newport by-election.
cards.quote: The Conservative Party selected as its candidate Donald Box, a stockbroker from Cardiff who had contested the seat at the 1955 general election.

cards.claim: The Conservatives ran the already selected Reginald Clarry as their candidate in the Newport by-election.
cards.quote: The Conservatives ran the already selected Reginald Clarry, a self-made man who had worked as a civil engineer.
